resolution_note_ru: R4A локализует область недостаточной сходимости, а не устанавливает физическую аномалию. Переклассификация одной точки второго семейства при продлении эволюции не является полной бисекцией. Знак производной компактности — диагностическое свидетельство, не достаточный критерий окончательного рассеивания.

classification.primary: R4A unchanged: near-trapping proxy if peak C>=.85, dispersal proxy if inner mass fraction<.05 and final C<.2, else unresolved; numerical failure preserved
classification.diagnostic: DISPERSAL_TREND_ONLY if no prior near trapping, inner mass fraction<.05 and fitted compactness slope strictly negative in each of four contiguous coordinate-time windows of width .5 ending at checkpoint, plus strictly decreasing endpoint C in each; never overrides primary class; report sample counts
classification.interpretation: mass drift gate applies on entire recorded interval; failure invalidates scientific interpretation, not the raw class record; no claim of horizon or converged continuum outcome

comparisons: match central proper time over common support; compare central derivative L2 all and jointly resolved (both curvature length/h>=8), fraction resolved, both curvature estimators at peak, peak curvature ratios; report 1536/3072 and 3072/6144; no extrapolated critical exponent

future.n12288: separate preregistered extension if 6144 not decisive; no inference until actual run
future.amr: conservative transfer, constraints, CFL, uniform comparison and >=8 resolved cells before DSS
future.dss: freeze observable, proper-time transform, lag range, search statistic, false alarm calibration and sampling before execution. Include shuffled residual controls and noncritical amplitude 0.05; log-uniform offsets around independently bounded critical amplitude 5–10 per decade as initial sampling design, validate actual coverage in log proper time; do not tune to expected Delta. No echo detection in R4B0.
future.third_family: blind independent amplitude family, criteria and hyperparameters sealed before first run; not included in R4B0
